title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：transition　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 transition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the observer ① made the transition that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the night. The ② transition, meaning the change itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a transition, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ transition in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ transition at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A transition, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the transition was the whole of the matter, meaning the passage and not the change. The ⑥ transition, meaning the passage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; transition, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a change and a passage. He said the passage is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ transition had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ transition of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; transition, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ transition I remember is the change described in the log, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ transition, my mother said in 1986, is the only change that improves by being described; every transition, she said, is a passage that has agreed to look like a change. She said the passage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 过渡；转变（指观测站里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 过渡；转变（指那次过渡本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the transition 完成这一次过渡
D. n. 过渡；转变（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 过渡之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的过渡之事）
F. n. 过渡；转变（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一次）
G. n. 过渡、转折（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 转折（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the transition that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The transition, meaning the change itself and not the lens
the transition at the far dome
the transition was the whole of the matter
the transition had become a line in a log
The transition of the whole thing
A transition, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: make the transition 意为“完成这一次过渡”，1977 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一次过渡做了一遍。
transition 意为“过渡；转变”，指那次过渡本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
transition 意为“过渡；转变”，指观测站里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
transition 意为“过渡；转变”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
transition 意为“过渡、转折”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次转折就是那件事的全部。
transition 意为“转折”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次过渡，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
transition 意为“过渡；转变”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一次，到 1982 年这一次成了观测记录里的一行。
transition 意为“过渡之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的过渡之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
transition 意为“过渡；转变”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一次，1984 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一次。
transition 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，过渡是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的过渡。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年那位观测员完成了观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一次过渡，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（make the transition）
那次过渡，指的是那次过渡本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。（transition）
那处观测站里每一次过渡旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（transition）
最远那座圆顶那次过渡，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（transition）
叔叔说这次转折就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那次过渡。（transition）
1986 年母亲说，过渡是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的过渡。（transition）
answers: In 1977 the observer made the transition that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the night.

Every transition in that observatory had the same short lens beside it.
The transition at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the transition was the whole of the matter, meaning the passage and not the change.
A transition, my mother said in 1986, is the only change that improves by being described.
